title: Product Review | Daler Rowney FW Acrylic Inks and Pearlescent Inks
description:
Just a quick honest review - trying to figure out how to best use these Daler Rowney FW Inks in my art work - I love the pearlescent FW inks, but a little more dubious about the regular colours.

This video shows my explorations and experiments with these Acrylic Inks.

0:52 Price as of September 2025
1:15 1st Impressions of these inks
1:25 Trying them with the ink diffusion method
2:48 Trying them with a splatter technique
3:06 Trying them neat on my Zentangle/Neurographic Drawings
4:07 Trying more ink and 
4:32 Diluting the ink
5:19 The pearlescent inks, using them neat and diluted
6:09 Looking at how other people use these FW Inks
6:26 Messy time experiments, spray bottles and isopropanol
6:59 Using them on different papers
7:58 Value for money and conclusions

I'm learning new art techniques and I do try to show the good with the bad, to set realistic expectations in a world full of false perfectionism.

After becoming ill in October 2022 and being diagnosed with Graves’ Disease (in remission as of October 2024), I decided to start sharing tutorials for all of my flowers and creations. After spending eight years perfecting my techniques, I had to close my selling platforms due to my health — but I didn’t want that knowledge to be lost. So, I began sharing everything here on YouTube to help others learn and create too.

Since then, I’ve also been diagnosed with Connective Tissue Disease (February 2024) and Cutaneous Lupus (June 2024). I now live with chronic fatigue, brain fog, and episodes of pain and exhaustion. Because of that, I’ve shifted my focus to exploring art techniques and crafts I’ve always wanted to try but never made time for.

Drawing has become my go-to creative outlet — something I can do quietly, even on difficult days. For anyone dealing with chronic fatigue syndrome or autoimmune conditions, I can’t recommend it enough. Sometimes, a sketchbook and pencil can bring far more peace than endless doom-scrolling.
